decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster is a core component of the firm's coolant management offer and stayed on the website through 2024, so dropping it would weaken the established portfolio.
The coolant cleaning centrifuge supports the firm's filtration and sustainability positioning and remained listed, so keeping it fits the strategy.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a staple product for metalworking customers and remained visible on the website, so they are likely to be retained.
Hinged belt chip conveyors are a standard product in this market and the firm kept it listed, so it complements the conveyor range.
